# web-platform-tests url tests: provenance

- Source: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt, branch `master`, commit
  `ce5ca39646886a9349fc42913f843ec6e1c8a36f` (2026-10-28), the same commit as
  `third_party/testing/wpt-encoding`.
- Copied unchanged into `third_party/testing/wpt-url/url/`: the data files of
  `url/resources/` (`urltestdata.json`, `urltestdata-javascript-only.json`,
  `setters_tests.json`, `toascii.json`, `IdnaTestV2.json`,
  `IdnaTestV2-removed.json`, `percent-encoding.json`) and the test files that
  read them (`url-constructor.any.js`, `url-origin.any.js`,
  `url-setters.any.js`, `toascii.window.js`, `IdnaTestV2.any.js`,
  `IdnaTestV2-removed.any.js`, `url-statics-canparse.any.js`,
  `url-statics-parse.any.js`, `percent-encoding.window.js`); the repository
  `LICENSE.md`. The test files are kept as the record of what each case
  checks; `tests/whatwg-url/run.mjs` does the same loop over the data.
- Copied on 2026-10-29.
- `IdnaTestV2.json` is generated by wpt's `url/tools/IdnaTestV2-parser.py`
  from Unicode IDNA `IdnaTestV2.txt` version 18.0.0 (2026-02-04): running that
  script on the 18.0.0 file gives the vendored JSON byte for byte; the 17.0.0
  and 16.0.0 files do not.
- Specification under test: URL Standard (WHATWG Living Standard), Last
  Updated 19 October 2026, commit snapshot `845bafca22fb0c5a42c4bf384a9bdea525a2f10d`
  of https://github.com/whatwg/url.
- Licence: 3-Clause BSD (`LICENSE.md`).
- Runner: `tests/whatwg-url/run.sh` (builds `lake exe l4whatwg-url`, then
  `tests/whatwg-url/run.mjs`). The `<a>` and `<area>` parts of
  `toascii.window.js` need an HTML document: https://github.com/danbri/factoidal/issues/1187.
